title: KW T909 Custom Built 5 Bar Heavy Duty Road Trian FUPS Compliant Bullbar #98
description: Kenworth T909 high tensile fully polished aluminium custom built 5 bar FUPS Bullbar 381 style channel. 100 mm diameter 6mm wall hi-tensile one piece pipe passing through drilled hi-tensile uprights for maximum protection. No butt welds. Optional 78mm or 88mm pipe can be ordered. Flat bar mounts for driving lights to customer requirements. Heavy duty box 100mm uprights shown with outer uprights to the bottom of the main channel & cowcatcher with 4 small uprights. Reversible aluminium Road Train signs plus provision for canvas Long Vehicle & Oversize signs. Combination indicator/parking lights mounted in outer uprights. Heavy duty backing plate with 38mm tow pin, Optional hi-tensile aluminium backing plate available on request giving up to an 80kg saving over the steel backing plate. Provision for front mudflaps. Helper spring fitted to assist with raising and lowering the bar. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
